content.text:
I'm tracing the filled diamond shape row by row, figuring out which sides become the two longer edges when the fill toggles to just the outline.

The diamond's four vertices are at (5,6), (8,9), (14,3), and (11,0), and comparing side lengths shows the two anti-diagonal edges — (8,9)-(14,3) and (11,0)-(5,6) — are the longer sides to keep, each spanning 7 cells. Everything else in the shape gets zeroed out.
